name: Mubert
tagline: Royalty-free AI music generated in real time from samples licensed from human producers.
description: Mubert generates royalty-free music for content, apps, and brands by composing in real time from a library of more than a million samples contributed by 4,000+ musicians. Render makes soundtracks fitted to a video's exact mood and duration, the API streams adaptive music into products, and the Play apps serve generated stations for listeners.
insight: Launched in 2017 — years before the genAI music wave — and pays royalties to the producers whose licensed samples its AI composes from.

modelSupport.notes: Proprietary generative engine that composes from licensed, human-made samples.

edge: Composes from human-licensed samples rather than scraped recordings, so tracks stay royalty-free and DMCA-safe for monetized content.
pros: Tracks fit exact mood and duration
cons: Geared to background music, not songs
Less granular control than a DAW

references.title: Raising $2.6M to Build an AI-Powered Music Stock
